child.code:
channels:history   public channels (IDs starting with C)
groups:history     private channels (IDs starting with G, or C in newer workspaces)
im:history         direct messages (IDs starting with D)
mpim:history       group direct messages

what the room shows                                     what to do
acme/C0123456789: conversations.history: missing_scope  add channels:history, Reinstall, paste the new xoxp-
acme/D0123456789: conversations.history: missing_scope  add im:history, Reinstall, paste the new xoxp-
acme/G0123456789: conversations.history: missing_scope  add groups:history (mpim:history for a group DM)
acme/C0123456789: conversations.history: not_in_channel invite the app to the channel; check the ID
acme: auth.test: invalid_auth                           the token is wrong or revoked: paste it again
acme: no token                                          workspaces[].token is empty (socket needs it too)
Connection error: apps.connections.open: invalid_auth   the appToken is wrong: an xapp- token, connections:write
Connection error: no appToken                           workspaces[].appToken is missing (no hint is shown)
Connection error: disconnect: link_disabled (…)         Socket Mode is off in the app: turn it on again
Connection error: the connection closed                 it reconnects by itself; the schedule picks up the rest
